An '''unidentified creature''' resembling a [[Turtle/Legends|turtle]] resided within a river on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], and it was pulled out of the river by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], who mistook it for the sunken canoe which he had been sailing in. The creature's body was within its shell when Teebo pulled it from the water, but it quickly withdrew its head and arms and spat a mouthful of water in Teebo's face, before he threw it back into the water.<ref name="2-14" />
